title: Easy Cherry Pie Made With Frozen Cherries
summary: This Cherry Pie made with frozen cherries is the perfect dessert any time of the year! With a flaky crust and sweet, vibrant filling, it’s simple to make, and absolutely delicious.
steps: The dough for at least an hour so it's easier to roll out, for the filling, simmer frozen cherries with sugar, lemon zest, and a touch of almond extract until it thickens into a sweet, jammy mixture, time to assemble.
Roll out the dough, fill your pie with that luscious cherry filling, and dot it with butter.
Then, create a beautiful lattice top using strips of dough.
Brush it with an egg wash and sprinkle with sugar for a perfectly golden finish, bake until.
Golden brown, and just like that, you have a gorgeous, bakery-worthy cherry pie ready to serve.
